verdict.rationale: Chargeback responses are a fair question for a payment processor like Adyen, so the axis applies. The pack has no documentation of a dispute or chargeback-defense capability: no evidence submission and no dispute status tracking. The risk-management items (Protect, rule builder, block/allow/review decisions) cover fraud prevention, which is an adjacent feature and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a finance-ops user, I can respond to a chargeback with structured evidence and track the dispute lifecycle to resolution
